title: Void an invoice
body:
Finance needs to void invoices that were issued by mistake.

Add `void_invoice(invoice_id)` to `parcelo/invoices.py`. It sets the invoice status to "void", stores the time of the void in a new `voided_at` field on `Invoice` (in `parcelo/models.py`), and returns the invoice.

Voiding an invoice that does not exist must fail. Voiding one that is already paid or already void must fail too.
